summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers and the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers into thin adapters. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; nifti_writer default dtype changed to np.float32; handlers updated (output_dir, filename, index parameters); examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py, and tests/integration_sliding_window.py switched to output_dir; test_handler_classification_saver.py passes filename; new tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Verification was static only: no line over 120 characters, correct file endings, no leftover old references, and no unused imports. Tests, flake8, and the ignite 0.3.0 attach check have NOT been run. Nothing committed.
